verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships AI agents, such as the SRE Agent, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents PagerDuty's own MCP server, which exposes PagerDuty to external AI clients. That is the server role, not the client role this story asks about. The SRE Agent's first-party GitHub and Sentry connectors and its Skills are adjacent features, not documented support for registering arbitrary MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
